commit.message:
Fix 128-bit SVE checks in ArrayTypeConvertTest.java in JDK25

ArrayTypeConvertTest.java is broken for 128-bit SVE2 machines since the
test expects vectorized two-lane "short" instructions but support for
those instruction doesn't exist in JDK25 (see JBS issue for details).

This patch updates the test (expected failure if we see vectorized
instructions) so that it correctly reflects the compiler's vectorization
ability.
